narrative.northStar: Warm, personal care — descriptive of the incumbent identity
narrative.overview: The supplied peach, beige and warm gold artwork defines the identity. Warm ivory surfaces and brown text extend it into a calm Arabic RTL shopping interface. The implementation is code-led and uses existing supplied assets. Review disposition: ship with limited viewport coverage; engine unavailable. Source documentation is not exhaustive rendered-device certification.
keyCharacteristics: Circular categories and softly rounded product imagery

rules.name: The Existing Identity Rule
rules.body: Extend the original warm artwork instead of replacing its palette with an unrelated visual world.

dos: Do retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do keep demo shopping disclosures visible.
donts: Don't crop campaign text on mobile.
Don't introduce heavy shadows across product cards.
